skills.name: Interfering Throw (干扰投掷/石投げ)
skills.line: That's what you get for bullying children!
skills.description: Kaoru viciously throws a stone at a single target, dealing damage equal 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Also decreases the target's the move bar by 15% if they have 4 or more buffs.

skills.name: Vigilant Owl (鸮之警惕/梟の警報)
skills.line: Get ready! This is the moment!
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the start of every turn (regardless of enemy or ally), Kaoru's status change triggers, changing her status to Play or Alert.
Kaoru usually stays in Play status. If two or more allies are inflicted with control effects, Kaoru's status will change to Alert. ;Play (遊び) :Kaoru's default status. ;Alert (警戒) : :Increases SPD by 10 and RES by 40%.

upgrades.text: If she is in Play status, increases all allies' damage dealt by 10% at the end of her turn until her status change.

skills.name: Warm Protection (温柔的守护/優しい守護)
skills.description:
Kaoru spends 25% of her current HP to grant Owl's Protection to an ally, sustained for 1 turn. Also dispels 1 debuff or control effect from each ally.
If Kaoru is an Alert status, allies inflicted with control effects gain Owl's Dance, lasts for 2 turns. If not, gain 4 onibi instead. ;Owl's Protection (梟の守り) :'''Buff, Mark''': When receiving damage, absorbs and records all damage received. When the mark fails, causes the protected ally to lose 80% of the amount recorded. :''(A nest of yellow feathers will appear around the protected ally's lower body.)'' ;Owl's Dance (梟の舞) : :'''Buff, Status''': Increases SPD by 50. ;Alert (警戒) : :Increases SPD by 10 and RES by 40%.

upgrades.text: When the Owl's Protection fails, lost HP decreases to 70%.
When the Owl's Protection fails, lost HP decreases to 60%.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically grants Owl's Protection to the ally with the lowest HP at the start of battle (sustained for 1 turn).

bio.condition: With Kaoru clear any zone 40 times.
